department_overview.introduction: The College of Computer Science & Information Studies was one of the most prominent and oldest centers of computer education in Faisalabad. It was established as a separate department by offering ICS program in 1999. The department expanded by offering BS (CS) in 2001, MCS in 2004, MS (CS) in 2009, and BS (IT) as per HEC guidelines. Later, the Department of Information Technology became a separate entity focusing on IT specialization and started MS (IT) in 2014. The department provides advanced computing facilities and aims to enhance practical knowledge of students through well-equipped laboratories and academic support.
department_overview.history: Started in 1999 with ICS program, later expanded into BS, MS programs in CS and IT fields. Eventually IT became a separate department focusing on specialized IT education.
department_overview.about: A well-established computing department offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Computer Science and Information Technology with strong focus on labs, research, and practical skills development.
department_overview.short_description: A leading and historic computer science and IT department in Faisalabad providing quality education, research environment, and modern computing facilities.

vision_mission.vision: To establish an effective operational environment containing advanced technological infrastructure, industry collaboration and research culture to deliver quality services to the students in terms of teaching, market exposure and research respectively.
vision_mission.mission: To technically equip students by providing support for academic excellence through teaching and promoting research culture to meet the emerging needs of the students.
